cues: A uniform rod, mass two kilograms, length one metre, is hinged at one end and held horizontal.
A coin rests on its free end.
Does the coin stay on the rod as it swings down?
text: Here is a beautiful consequence. A uniform rod, mass two kilograms, length one metre, is hinged at one end and held horizontal. A coin rests on its free end. We let go. Does the coin stay on the rod as it swings down?
